neighbours.label: the subject pronoun right after a locative relative 'where' ("a place where they could ...")
fire: The family rented a cottage by the sea where they spent every summer.
Grandfather built a shed in the yard where he repaired old clocks.
Find a sunny corner of the balcony where you can grow some herbs.
The hikers reached a clearing where they pitched their tents.
Maria opened a small studio downtown where she taught pottery.
Our guide led us to a ridge where we watched the sun go down.
The monks founded a monastery in the hills where they kept bees.
The boy climbed to the attic where he hid his comic books.
quiet: The family rented a cottage by the sea because they loved the summer there.
Grandfather built a shed in the yard so that he could repair old clocks.
Find a sunny corner of the balcony and grow some herbs in pots.
The hikers reached a clearing before they pitched their tents.
Maria opened a small studio downtown after she finished her pottery course.
Our guide told us that we would watch the sun go down from a ridge.
The monks founded a monastery in the hills, and they kept bees.
The boy climbed to the attic while he was looking for his comic books.

notes: Probes: 'where they/you/we/he' + verb 0.43-0.89; 'because they' 0.09, 'that they' 0.01. The - pole is the where-is-X location question side (card).
